div.l: To seeken hym a chantery / for sowlis
Or with a brethirhed / to ben witholde
But dwellyd at home / and keepte vel his folde
So that the wolf / maade it nat myskarye
He was a shepherd / and nat a mecennarye
And thouh he holy were / and v ̉ertuous
He was nat to synfull men / dispytous
Ne of his speche / dangerous ne digne
But in his speche / discret and benigne
To drawen folk / to hevene bi fayrnesse
By good ensample / this was his bisynesse
But it were any ꝑpersone / obstynat
What so he were / of hye or lowe estat
Hym wold he snybbyn / sharply for the nones
A bettyr prest I trowe / nowher noon is
He wayted after / no pompe ne reverence
Ne maked hym / a spysed conscience
But cristes lore / and his a postelis twelwe
He tawhte / but first he folwed it hym selve
A Plowman̄VIth hym ther vas a plowmān / was his brothir
That hadde lad of donge / wel many a rother
A trewe swynker / and a good was he
Lyvyng in pes / and in ꝑperfyt charite
God loved he best / with all his hool herte
At alle tymes / thowh he gamed or smerte
And than his neihbore / ryht as hym selve
He wolde throisshe / and ther to dyke and delve
For cristes sake / with every pore wyht
Withouten here / if it lay in his myht
His tithis paide he ful faire and wel
Bothe of his propir swynk / and of his catel
In a tabbard he rood / vpon a mere
Ther was also a reve / and a mellere
